observations.finding: CAMAT 0.2.8 mei_validation on the unchanged file: no schema findings; 2 errors broken_internal_reference (<ref target="#xsl_ppq"> and "#xsl_header" in the change list point to IDs that are not in the file); 17 layer_duration_underfull warnings (partial bars 1, 9, 10, 30, 31, 39, and staff 1 of 23, 24, 26, 27, 28); 14 Verovio warnings 'tie ... has both a @startid and an @tstamp'.
The 14 ties have no xml:id; Verovio names them with IDs it generates on each load, so the IDs in its warnings cannot be searched in the file.
Verovio 6.3.0 draws <pedal dir="down"> as SMuFL E650 (Ped.) and dir="up" as E655 (asterisk).
The 8va line starts in n 20 with tstamp2="4" and no bar offset; in the print it ends after the first note of n 21 (p. 43). Not changed.
